mapper.sql: a.id, a.student_id, a.academic_term, a.required_avg, a.elective_avg, a.total_credits, a.course_count, a.score_a, a.source, a.imported_by, a.note, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS class_name, sp.major AS major, sp.grade AS grade
FROM eval_academic a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_academic (student_id, academic_term, required_avg, elective_avg, total_credits, course_count, score_a, source, imported_by, note, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{academicTerm}, #{requiredAvg}, #{electiveAvg}, #{totalCredits}, #{courseCount}, #{scoreA}, #{source}, #{importedBy}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_academic SET required_avg = #{requiredAvg}, elective_avg = #{electiveAvg}, total_credits = #{totalCredits}, course_count = #{courseCount}, score_a = #{scoreA}, source = #{source}, imported_by = #{importedBy}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.academic_term = #{academicTerm} AND a.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE a.academic_term = #{academicTerm} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.student_id

SELECT sp.user_id AS studentId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS studentName, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS studentNo, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS className, sp.major AS major, sp.grade AS grade FROM student_profile sp LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = sp.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN eval_academic a ON a.student_id = sp.user_id AND a.academic_term = #{academicTerm} AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.status = 'active' AND (a.id IS NULL OR a.score_a IS NULL) ORDER BY sp.major, sp.grade, sp.class_name, studentNo
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eval_academic WHERE academic_term = #{academicTerm} AND deleted = 0 AND score_a IS NOT NULL
SELECT sp.user_id FROM student_profile sp WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.student_no = #{studentNo} ORDER BY sp.id LIMIT 1
